title: Introduction to Systems Analysis
description: Covers a range of methods and methodologies used in analyzing and designing various types of systems. Topics include; requirements gathering, specification and design; data and process modelling; user interface modelling and prototyping; and system testing, implementation and operation. Students gain practical experience as part of team designing and implementing a system as part of the course.
notes: Credit will only be granted for one of CSC 375, SENG 321.
